title: Read steps from left to right
summary: Elixir: Read steps from left to right. Raise the limit to 9.
introduction: The pipe |> passes a value as the first input to the next function.
learningObjectives: Read steps from left to right with Elixir

blocks.text: Install Elixir. Save each example as lesson.exs and run elixir lesson.exs.
Read steps from left to right

blocks.title: Read steps from left to right
blocks.code:
[4, 8, 9]
|> Enum.filter(fn n -> n >= 7 end)
|> Enum.sum()
|> IO.puts()

blocks.text: Filtering first keeps 8 and 9. The next piped function sums them to 17.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: The piped value becomes the first argument, not the last.
